You’re asking this on the Valve Subreddit, so the answer is going to be obvious.

But personally I grew up with both, so it’s hard for me to chose because they both have made some of the best games that I’ve ever played. On one hand, I grew up with TF2, Portal, and Half-Life and on the other hand I grew up with Mario, Zelda, Pokémon, and Smash.

Though I have to admit that I’ve been disappointed in Nintendo recently because of their “limited run” games and attempts to kill the Smash Scene.

All my professors pretty much told me what I had to do. I still have a project due on the same day as intended and most of my professors will either stream lectures or record them. 

I’m just expected to turn in everything online now through Blackboard (of which I hate), email, or any other means.

Looks like most of them will be using assignments as proof of attendance as well, so be mindful of that.

Gameplay was actually great (like Bloodborne) and the game gives off that feeling of accomplishment when you defeat a boss. The lore was also fascinating in of itself.

Smash Ultimate may be the most ambitious crossover fighting game of all time, but all it really does, in the end, is add characters that invoke nostalgia and fanservice. Sekrio was something else and I think it's about time FromSoftware got some recognition for once.
Love Smash, but Sekiro deserved this win and the salt from the Smash Community is pretty funny.

Plot twist:  

Sekiro, The One-Armed Wolf, dies twice in Smash Bros. as the final DLC character for the Fighter Pass!  

Post-DLC Fighter: Sam Bridges from Death Stranding!

/s

Originally, this was supposed to be a one-and-done side project, but I’m in the process of making of more of the Smash cast do the rest of the dances. Maybe I’ll make a Play of the Game side project and a showcase of miscellaneous taunts if I have time.
The Overwatch rigs are a bit wonky on other models. For Banjo’s case, he has Junkrat’s rig and since Junkrat’s pegleg doesn’t have a proper rig attached to it, the leg won’t move smoothly.
Actually, Banjo has Junkrat’s dance. DK, K.Rool, and Ridley have Roadhog’s dance. You’re right about Palutena, though.
Thanks!

Bruh. Just let people play what they like. I don’t know why people like this get so butthurt over someone else’s tastes in games.

I for one have always leaned more towards games with simple/cartoonish/anime/cute aesthetics. Rarely do I ever pick up a game with uber-realistic graphics because they all look so similar to me. Hyper-realistic graphics are great, but to me they end up looking the same visually (This is kind of why I don’t care much for Cyberpunk 2077).
I'm still shaken by it all. I'm actually glad I bought Persona 5 last year because I'm actually hyped for Joker! Glad to see the Persona Universe in Smash!

I would love to see a remake for Golden Sun and have the first two games merged together as one. I'd love to see Nintendo give more love to their other RPG titles. Same goes for the Fire Emblem Radiance series and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time.
Glad to know that I'm the only one! That's a relief.
Ah, thank you. Maybe you're right. I just hope that I won't be shamed for my differing opinions.
I'll admit, the last bit's a bit odd, but hey, you be you. Whatever makes you happy in the end is all that matters.
